sourceAudit.seaExtent: maritimeRfSeaClutterFieldWip13A3 derives crossCell from range and beam-local azimuth sampling; rangeCell from existing rangeResolutionM
sourceAudit.compositeExtent: asmSeekerCompositeReturns uses power-weighted RMS of centroid separation plus member extents; no raw union bounding box
sourceAudit.measurement: asmSeekerEchoMeasurement does not add a resolution cell to extents; it reuses composite extents for glint sigma and target evidence

decision.reason: Directive-prescribed neutral-unobservable-axis normalization rejects previously valid stationary surface targets at 10-30 km. Threshold/weight fitting is prohibited.
